key_findings: Conditional deletion of DOR from parvalbumin cells (Floxed DOR; PV-Cre) abolishes DPDPE-mediated suppression of MThal-to-ACC feed-forward inhibition onto Layer V pyramidal neurons.
PV-DOR-KO reduces SNC80-induced convulsions and eliminates SNC80-induced catalepsy, but not PTZ-induced seizures.
SNC80's anxiolytic effect in the elevated plus maze is lost in PV-DOR-KO mice.
SNC80-induced hyperlocomotion and respiratory stimulation are preserved in PV-DOR-KO mice.
NTG-induced orbitofacial hyperalgesia develops normally in PV-DOR-KO mice and SNC80's antihyperalgesic effect is preserved, suggesting PV-DOR is not required for these pain effects.
